shortDescription: Create and delete a DigitalOcean Kubernetes cluster

options.name: auto_upgrade
options.description: A boolean value indicating whether the cluster will be automatically upgraded to new patch releases during its maintenance window.

options.name: ha
options.description: A boolean value indicating whether the control plane is run in a highly available configuration in the cluster. Highly available control planes incur less downtime.

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: An object specifying the maintenance window policy for the Kubernetes cluster (see table below).

options.name: name
options.description: A human-readable name for a Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: node_pools
options.description: An object specifying the details of the worker nodes available to the Kubernetes cluster (see table below).

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token; can be specified in C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_API_TOKEN), or C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) environment variables

options.name: project_name
options.description: Project to assign the resource to (project name, not UUID). Defaults to the default project of the account (empty string).

options.name: region
options.description: The slug identifier for the region where the Kubernetes cluster will be created.

options.name: return_kubeconfig
options.description: Controls whether or not to return the C(kubeconfig).

options.name: state
options.description: The usual, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy

options.name: surge_upgrade
options.description: A boolean value indicating whether surge upgrade is enabled/disabled for the cluster. Surge upgrade makes cluster upgrades fast and reliable by bringing up new nodes before destroying the outdated nodes.

options.name: tags
options.description: A flat array of tag names as strings to be applied to the Kubernetes cluster. All clusters will be automatically tagged "k8s" and "k8s:$K8S_CLUSTER_ID" in addition to any tags provided by the user.

options.name: version
options.description: The slug identifier for the version of Kubernetes used for the cluster. See the /v2/kubernetes/options endpoint for available versions.

options.name: vpc_uuid
options.description: A string specifying the UUID of the VPC to which the Kubernetes cluster will be assigned. If excluded, the cluster will be assigned to your account's default VPC for the region.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the cluster to be running before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds, when creating a cluster.
